lines.zh: 翅膀拍得很响，我沿着洞壁巡。
lines.en: My wings beat loudly as I patrol the cavern wall.

lines.zh: 我贴着蠕变石头飞，影子在下面跑。
lines.en: I fly low over creep stone, my shadow racing beneath.

lines.zh: 两片翅膀一抬，我就越过那道沟。
lines.en: A lift of both wings carries me over the gorge.

lines.zh: 风从裂缝里出来，我借它滑一段。
lines.en: Wind spills from the crack, and I glide on it.

lines.zh: 我飞得不快，但一直朝你那边。
lines.en: I do not fly fast, but always toward you.

lines.zh: 翅膀尖擦过石笋，声音很刺耳。
lines.en: My wingtip scrapes a stalagmite, a grating sound.

lines.zh: 我绕了半圈，找一个能落下的高台。
lines.en: I circle half a turn, seeking a ledge to land on.

lines.zh: 尾巴后拖，我飞得像一支弩箭。
lines.en: Tail trailing, I fly like a crossbow bolt.

lines.zh: 我拍一下翅膀，就越过两块石头。
lines.en: One wingbeat carries me over two stones.

lines.zh: 空气里有股焦味，是我自己带的。
lines.en: There is a burnt smell in the air — it comes from me.

lines.zh: 我压低了飞，几乎擦到地面。
lines.en: I drop low, almost grazing the ground.

lines.zh: 岩石的缝隙里有风，我钻进去又出来。
lines.en: Wind moves through the rock seam; I dive in and out.

lines.zh: 我不落地，落地就没法突然扑人。
lines.en: I do not land; landing would spoil my sudden pounce.

lines.zh: 翅膀酸了，我还是不肯停。
lines.en: My wings ache, and I still refuse to stop.

lines.zh: 我用翅尖点一下石壁，借力转向。
lines.en: I tap the stone wall with a wingtip and turn off it.

lines.zh: 洞里的气流往上升，我顺着它飘。
lines.en: The air in the cave rises, and I drift with it.

lines.zh: 我悬在半空，翅膜还在轻轻抖。
lines.en: I hang in the air, my wing membrane still quivering.

lines.zh: 引线藏在皮下，我听得见它响。
lines.en: The fuse lies under my skin; I can hear it tick.

lines.zh: 我不动时，像一截挂在洞顶的枯枝。
lines.en: Still, I look like dead wood hung from the ceiling.

lines.zh: 我在数还有多久才该炸。
lines.en: I am counting how long until I should blow.

lines.zh: 翅膀收起来，我落在一块蘑菇上。
lines.en: Wings folded, I settle on a mushroom.

lines.zh: 我咕哝了一声，声音像漏气的皮囊。
lines.en: I grunt, a sound like a leaking bladder.

lines.zh: 焦味越来越重，我习惯了。
lines.en: The burnt smell thickens; I am used to it.

lines.zh: 我把头歪着，看你有没有破绽。
lines.en: I tilt my head, checking you for an opening.

lines.zh: 我的四个爪尖扣在石头上，很稳。
lines.en: My four claw tips grip the stone, steady.

lines.zh: 蠕变的光很暗，正适合我藏着。
lines.en: Creep light is dim — good for something like me.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀张开又合上，试试风向。
lines.en: I open and close my wings, testing the wind.

lines.zh: 我不想炸，可我天生就是这个用法。
lines.en: I would rather not explode, but that is what I am for.

lines.zh: 你抬头了，那我们就正式认识。
lines.en: You looked up — now we are properly introduced.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，看它会不会举起什么。
lines.en: I watch your hands to see if they will raise anything.

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，近得我翅尖发痒。
lines.en: You stand too close; it makes my wingtips itch.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在我身上停了很久。
lines.en: Your eyes rest on me for a long while.

lines.zh: 我看你，不表示我喜欢你。
lines.en: Me looking at you does not mean I like you.

lines.zh: 你身后的墙，退路我都记下了。
lines.en: The wall behind you — I have marked every way out.

lines.zh: 你在衡量距离，我也在。
lines.en: You measure the space between us; so do I.

lines.zh: 别对我笑，我的引线认得火。
lines.en: Do not smile at me; my fuse knows fire.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，是我靠得太近。
lines.en: Your breathing falters — I am too close.

lines.zh: 我们就这样看着，看谁先动。
lines.en: We keep looking, to see who moves first.

lines.zh: 疼，但我的引线没有熄。
lines.en: It hurts, but my fuse has not gone out.

lines.zh: 你打中我的翅膀，我歪着飞。
lines.en: You struck my wing; I fly crooked now.

lines.zh: 再打我几下，我就提前炸给你看。
lines.en: Hit me a few more times and I blow early.

lines.zh: 我的翅膜破了个洞，风从那儿漏。
lines.en: There is a hole in my membrane; wind leaks through.

lines.zh: 你这一下让我更想贴住你。
lines.en: That blow only makes me want to cling to you.

lines.zh: 我流血，可引线还在烧。
lines.en: I bleed, and the fuse keeps burning.

lines.zh: 疼得我嘶嘶响，那声音不是我装的。
lines.en: Pain makes me hiss, and that hiss is no act.

lines.zh: 我的爪子松了一只，飞得晃。
lines.en: One claw has gone slack; I wobble in flight.

lines.zh: 你砍中了，可我还有半条命。
lines.en: You landed the hit, but I still have half a life.

lines.zh: 别以为疼就能让我走。
lines.en: Do not think pain will make me leave.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，让我浑身发紧。
lines.en: The torch in your hand makes my whole body tighten.

lines.zh: 有火光的地方，我总想凑过去。
lines.en: Where there is firelight, I always want to come closer.

lines.zh: 那点火星落在石上，我看呆了。
lines.en: Those sparks land on stone, and I stare, spellbound.

lines.zh: 你要是点火，我就当你在邀请我。
lines.en: Light a flame and I will take it as an invitation.

lines.zh: 我心里那根引线，被光一照就痒。
lines.en: The fuse inside me itches whenever light touches it.

lines.zh: 别拿打火石对着我，我会失控。
lines.en: Do not point flint and steel at me; I lose control.

lines.zh: 火药味飘过来，我的翅膜都在颤。
lines.en: Gunpowder scent drifts by, and my wing membrane trembles.

lines.zh: 这一带太亮了，我待不住。
lines.en: This place is too bright; I cannot stay.

lines.zh: 热的东西对我有吸引力，我说不清为什么。
lines.en: Heat draws me, and I cannot say why.

lines.zh: 你越点火，我越不想走。
lines.en: The more you strike sparks, the less I want to leave.

lines.zh: 我撞在你胸口，翅膀全乱了。
lines.en: I hit your chest and my wings tangle completely.

lines.zh: 洞顶太矮，我一头撞上了。
lines.en: The ceiling is too low; I struck it head-on.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡我，指节磕到我的牙。
lines.en: You raise a hand; my teeth meet your knuckles.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，两个都没站稳。
lines.en: We crashed together; neither of us kept footing.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀碰上你的盾，声音很闷。
lines.en: My wing meets your shield with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我引线都晃了。
lines.en: That impact rattled even my fuse.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我就不必再撞。
lines.en: Take one step back and I need not hit you again.

lines.zh: 石头比你还硬，我撞得牙疼。
lines.en: The stone is harder than you; my teeth ache.

lines.zh: 我们隔着一层翅膜互相抵着。
lines.en: We press against each other through a layer of wing membrane.

lines.zh: 我不怕撞，我怕撞了还不炸。
lines.en: I do not fear impact; I fear hitting without exploding.

lines.zh: 你身上也有焦味，是同类吗？
lines.en: You smell of scorching too — are you one of mine?

lines.zh: 两只一起飞，翼尖会互相碰到。
lines.en: Flying together, our wingtips keep touching.

lines.zh: 找个高一点的地方，我们并排挂着。
lines.en: Find a high place where we can hang side by side.

lines.zh: 我不太会示好，只会把翅膀放低。
lines.en: I am poor at courting; I only lower my wings.

lines.zh: 你若先炸了，我会记住那声响。
lines.en: If you go off first, I will remember the sound.

lines.zh: 我们的窝不用建，随便一处洞顶就行。
lines.en: We need no nest; any ceiling will do.

lines.zh: 同类太少，遇见你算运气。
lines.en: My kind are few; meeting you is luck.

lines.zh: 别飞太远，我追不上你的翅膀。
lines.en: Do not fly far; I cannot match your wings.

lines.zh: 我们一起绕洞三圈，就算定了。
lines.en: Three laps of the cavern together, and it is settled.

lines.zh: 我把最响的那声留给我们俩。
lines.en: I save the loudest blast for the two of us.

lines.zh: 我抓起一块石头，飞起来很费劲。
lines.en: I grab a stone and struggle to get airborne.

lines.zh: 火药渣落在地上，我一片片捡。
lines.en: Gunpowder grit falls to the floor; I pick up each bit.

lines.zh: 我爪子里夹着东西，飞得歪。
lines.en: With something in my claws, I fly crooked.

lines.zh: 这块石头有点热，我舍不得丢。
lines.en: This stone is warm, and I am loath to drop it.

lines.zh: 我捡东西只是为了往下扔。
lines.en: I pick things up only to drop them on someone.

lines.zh: 翅膀带着重量，得拍得更用力。
lines.en: With the weight, my wings must beat harder.

lines.zh: 我把那块铁片藏在洞顶的缝里。
lines.en: I hide that iron scrap in a crack overhead.

lines.zh: 捡到一半，引线又响了。
lines.en: Halfway through picking it up, the fuse ticks again.

lines.zh: 你的掉落物，我先替你拿着。
lines.en: Your dropped item — I will hold it for you.

lines.zh: 抱着东西飞，我连转弯都难。
lines.en: Carrying a load, I can barely turn.

lines.zh: 你走进洞里，我的翅膀就停了。
lines.en: You walk into the cavern, and my wings stop.

lines.zh: 那个背影不错，我记下了。
lines.en: That silhouette will do; I have noted it.

lines.zh: 我一看见活动的东西，引线就热。
lines.en: The moment I see something moving, my fuse warms.

lines.zh: 你的脚步在石头上很响，藏不住。
lines.en: Your steps ring on the stone; you cannot hide.

lines.zh: 目标站在光里，太容易找了。
lines.en: The target stands in the light, far too easy to find.

lines.zh: 有只蝙蝠飞过，我放过了它。
lines.en: A bat flies past, and I let it go.

lines.zh: 我看见你的盾，还是决定过去。
lines.en: I see your shield and still decide to come.

lines.zh: 这一带有活物，我闻到了。
lines.en: There is something alive here; I smell it.

lines.zh: 你背对着我，这不太公平。
lines.en: You have your back to me — hardly fair.

lines.zh: 我挑中了最靠边的那个。
lines.en: I have chosen the one nearest the edge.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，等一个最好的角度。
lines.en: I lower myself, waiting for the best angle.

lines.zh: 你的盾挡着正面，我得绕到侧面。
lines.en: Your shield guards the front, so I must flank.

lines.zh: 我数着三步，三步之内我就到。
lines.en: I count three steps; within three I am there.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀收窄，好从缝里穿过去。
lines.en: I narrow my wings to slip through the gap.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，反而更好办了。
lines.en: You retreat to the corner, which makes it easier.

lines.zh: 引线在我胸口响，你也听见了吧。
lines.en: The fuse ticks in my chest — you hear it too.

lines.zh: 我绕着你上方转，找落点。
lines.en: I circle above you, looking for a landing point.

lines.zh: 你一举盾，我就换个方向。
lines.en: Raise your shield, and I change direction.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚，脚不动你就跑不了。
lines.en: I watch your feet; still feet cannot run.

lines.zh: 再近一点，近到我能碰到你。
lines.en: A little closer, close enough for me to touch you.

lines.zh: 我先咬你一口，再把自己点着。
lines.en: First I bite you, then I set myself alight.

lines.zh: 这一撞只是开场，后面才是正事。
lines.en: This ram is only the opening; the real thing follows.

lines.zh: 我的牙不尖，可我的肚子会炸。
lines.en: My teeth are blunt, but my belly will burst.

lines.zh: 你打我一下，我就靠得更近。
lines.en: Hit me once and I press closer.

lines.zh: 我撞在你盾上，引线烧得更快了。
lines.en: I slam your shield and the fuse burns faster.

lines.zh: 别退，退了我也追得上来。
lines.en: Do not retreat; I can catch up even so.

lines.zh: 这一口是提醒你，快跑。
lines.en: This bite is a reminder: start running.

lines.zh: 我的爪子扣住你的袖子。
lines.en: My claws catch in your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我们之间只剩一步了。
lines.en: Only one step remains between us.

lines.zh: 你听见那声嘶响了吗？来不及了。
lines.en: Did you hear that hiss? Too late now.

lines.zh: 蠕变维度的石头裂开，我爬出来。
lines.en: The creep stone splits, and I crawl out.

lines.zh: 我在暗处张开翅膀，先试了试风。
lines.en: I spread my wings in the dark and test the air.

lines.zh: 这里没有太阳，正合我意。
lines.en: No sun reaches here — exactly what I want.

lines.zh: 我从洞顶掉下来，落地前就飞住了。
lines.en: I drop from the ceiling and catch myself before landing.

lines.zh: 一睁开眼，引线就已经在了。
lines.en: I open my eyes, and the fuse is already there.

lines.zh: 这处裂隙够暗，我就在这里等着。
lines.en: This fissure is dark enough; I will wait here.

lines.zh: 我生来就带着火药味。
lines.en: I was born smelling of gunpowder.

lines.zh: 翅膀先硬，然后我才学会飞。
lines.en: My wings hardened first, then I learned to fly.

lines.zh: 蠕变的光在我翅膜上晃。
lines.en: Creep light flickers across my wing membrane.

lines.zh: 我在石缝里孵了很久，终于出来了。
lines.en: I brooded long in the crack and finally emerged.

lines.zh: 火对我没用，我本来就是火。
lines.en: Fire is useless on me; I am fire already.

lines.zh: 从洞顶掉下来，我摔得翅膀发麻。
lines.en: Falling from the ceiling leaves my wings numb.

lines.zh: 水灌进翅膜，我飞不起来了。
lines.en: Water fills my wing membrane and I cannot fly.

lines.zh: 别人的爆炸，先炸到了我。
lines.en: Someone else's blast hits me first.

lines.zh: 箭穿过翅膜，我差点掉下去。
lines.en: An arrow through my membrane nearly drops me.

lines.zh: 那股力量捏住我，引线都凉了。
lines.en: That force grips me, and my fuse goes cold.

lines.zh: 我饿得连火都点不着。
lines.en: Hunger has left me too weak to strike a spark.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，火药先响了。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and the gunpowder goes off first.

lines.zh: 脚下没有东西，我一直往下掉。
lines.en: Nothing beneath me, and I keep falling.
